title: Stop hook blocks orchestrator while a fixer agent runs in background
body:
What happened: The orchestrator delegated a fix step (PG-302 fix-1) to a warden:fixer subagent running in the background. While it ran, the Stop hook blocked the orchestrator's turn three times with "PG-302 is at fix-1 and needs you. Run: warden next (or warden wait while a gate runs)."
Expected: No block while a background agent is working on the step. Or the orchestrate skill says how to wait.
Steps: 1) /warden:orchestrate on an epic. 2) A ticket reaches a fix step. 3) Start warden:fixer in the background. 4) End the turn to wait for the agent's notification.
Evidence: Stop hook blocking error from command: "warden hook stop": warden: PG-302 is at fix-1 and needs you. Run: warden next (or warden wait while a gate runs).
note: Fixed. Stop no longer blocks an orchestrating session or a session whose fixer is still working.
